title: HR Intern
description:
**Job Title:** 
 HR Intern / Executive Assistant to Founder's Office (Full\-time \| On\-site)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 0\-1 Years (Freshers with high energy are welcome)
   

  

**Company:** 
 Marketing Mojito
   

  

**About Marketing Mojito:** 
 Marketing Mojito is a full\-stack digital marketing agency built for business transformation. Here, you won't be "just an employee." You'll build brands from scratch, run end\-to\-end campaigns, and watch your ideas go live. With our learning\-first culture, you'll pick up the skills that matter, strategy, performance, content, design and analytics, while owning real outcomes. Come for the challenge; stay for the growth.
   

  

**The Vibe:** 
 Marketing Mojito is a high\-energy zone. We don't do "slow corporate HR" or boring back\-office admin. We are looking for a
 **People Person \& Operator** 
 who can spot talent from a mile away and keep the agency's heartbeat strong. You will be the bridge between the Founders and the team, ensuring that we hire the best, work efficiently, and actually enjoy the process.
   

  

**The Mission:** 
 You won't just "file papers" here. You will be the gatekeeper of our culture and the right hand to the leadership. Your mission is to build the team (Recruitment), keep the team happy (Culture), and help the Founders focus on growth by handling the operational chaos.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Do**
* The Talent Scout: You are the first filter. You will screen CVs, cold\-call candidates to assess their "vibe" and communication skills, and arrange interviews with the leadership.
* Pipeline Builder: You won't just wait for applications. You will actively tie up with institutes and colleges to build a steady pipeline of interns and freshers.
* Founder's Office Ops: You will handle miscellaneous, high\-priority tasks from the Founders' office. This requires research, coordination, and the ability to get things done without a manual.
* Chief Fun Officer: You own the vibe. You will organize office parties, birthdays, and team\-building events. If the office is quiet, it's your job to fix it.
* The Watchtower: You will keep an eye on team performance, daily attendance, and discipline to ensure the agency runs like a well\-oiled machine.


**You Bring**
* 0\-1 Year of Experience / High\-Potential Fresher: You might be new, but you are hungry to learn how a business is built.
* The Gift of Gab: You are not afraid to pick up the phone and talk to anyone—from a nervous intern candidate to a college placement officer.
* Organizational Ninja: You can manage the Founders' calendars, interview schedules, and office spreadsheets without losing track.
* High EQ: You understand people. You know how to be firm regarding attendance/performance but fun regarding culture/parties.


**Why Marketing Mojito?**
* Direct Mentorship: You work directly with the Founders/CEO. You will learn the secrets of running a business.
* Real Impact: You aren't a cog in the wheel. The people you hire will shape the future of the agency.
* Culture: We value output over hours. We work hard in Chembur, but we celebrate wins properly.

title: Senior Change Manager - ISC & MEA OU
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.

**About the role**


The Senior Change Manager is crucial in shaping how people experience and contribute to change across Haleon. The role enables, coordinates and executes our strategic programmes, owning the local change strategy and roadmap within an assigned Operating Unit or Function to ensure a coherent change experience.


The role will focus on the people side of change \- identifying, preparing, and equipping our colleagues to adopt changes in ways of working, roles, operating models, business processes, systems, technology, culture and more. It will report into the Change Management CoE Director (Centre of Excellence) and support a collaborative effort to drive change excellence at scale. This role involves significant stakeholder engagement and strategic change partnering to coordinate activities and act as a bridge between programmes and local teams on change. It will require close collaboration across a variety of stakeholders to scope, understand, localize and implement changes and cultivate a local change network.


This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced individual to join a leading global organization with an exciting transformation agenda. We are seeking individuals with demonstrable experience and passion for designing and executing strategic change locally, as well as contributing to developing Haleon’s broader transformation capability.

**Key responsibilities**

**Change Strategy \& Planning**

* Drive the execution of strategic transformation initiatives landing in assigned Operating Unit or Function by developing a change strategy and actionable roadmap.

* Ensure alignment to Haleon’s culture strategy throughout change planning and execution, embedding behavioural shifts for true adoption.

**Change Execution \& Adoption**

* Proactively support the delivery and adoption of change, including facilitating workshops, defining success metrics, assessing change effectiveness, measuring adoption and coordinating local knowledge management plans.
* Partner with Programmes to develop local business readiness criteria ahead of going\-live with change initiatives.
* Hold programme and business leads to account for leader\-led change execution.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication**

* Anticipate stakeholder needs and potential areas of resistance to drive change outcomes, proactively identifying targeted mitigations.
* Coordinate change activities across relevant stakeholders and teams (HR, Communications, Programmes, Capability Leads, L\&D, etc.), acting as a bridge between Programmes and local teams
* Develop and oversee the implementation of local communications and engagement plans, including mapping key stakeholders, agreeing the engagement approach with business leaders and HR, and tailoring programme change narratives for local needs.

**Change Capability Building**

* Build a holistic change capability strategy and plan for assigned Operating Unit or Function, ensuring alignment to the enterprise skills framework.
* Develop and execute the change learning plan and curriculum with subject matter experts, partnering with Programme leads, Capability Leads, and HR to identify training needs and ensure appropriate training plans are in place, including measuring effectiveness.
* Coach and upskill business leaders on change management, holding them to account for role modelling change and culture and driving uptake in their Operating Unit or Function.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing through the change management community of practice.

**Change Measurement, Risk \& Benefits Management**

* Review and report on change outcomes and benefits, grounded in metrics, with clear return on investment and linked to business outcomes.
* Identify, document and support the mitigation of key change management risks within the assigned Operating Unit or Function, working effectively across workstreams to implement interventions and resolve issues.

 **Qualifications and Skills:**

* Proven track record of executing change programmes within complex, matrixed environments, demonstrating ability to operate effectively across diverse, global teams.
* Proficiency with portfolio\-level change management including prioritization, sequencing and operating across interdependent transformations.
* Ability to translate an enterprise\-level change strategy and roadmap into an executable and measurable change and adoption plan for local deployment.
* Strong understanding of change management best practice, including tools, techniques and their practical implementation.
* Ability to effectively influence and navigate across a broad ecosystem of business stakeholders including Leaders and Line Managers, as well as fellow capability areas e.g. HRBPs, L\&D, responsible for collectively delivering change.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to simplify complex messages on change and present to business leaders.
* Strong problem solving and planning skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity and adapt the delivery approach in a changing environment.

**Preferred**

* PROSCI and/or APMG Change Practitioner certification preferred but not essential.
* Strong business acumen and understanding of business operations and operating model components, including structure, governance, processes and ways of working and ability to frame the change strategy within wider business objectives.
* Demonstrated ability to coach sponsors, cultivate change and culture champions and drive business accountability for change.
* Solid understanding of how people experience change and the drivers of change, with experience of embedding mindset and culture shifts across teams to sustain organizational and behavioral change.
* Strong data fluency with the ability to leverage analytics and insights to drive adoption, and proficiency with change management, collaboration, and digital adoption tools.

description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-243158 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: May. 07, 2026 CATEGORY: Supply Chain
**HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?**


If you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever\-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of.

**Senior Associate, Compliance Management (Amgen External Planning)**

**What you will do**


Let’s do this! Let’s change the world! In this vital role you will be part of the External Planning and Delivery Team, which is responsible for strategy and execution of all aspects of supply chain supporting our external manufacturing network.


The Senior Associate Amgen External Planning (AXP) reports to the Business Performance Manager of Supply Planning at the Amgen India, Hyderabad site. In this role, the Senior Associate Supply Chain Compliance is responsible for leading and maintaining compliance infrastructure for the External Planning organization ensuring that all GMP and non\-GMP documentation, training, and procedural requirements are established, maintained, and continuously improved to support operational excellence. This individual will serve as the compliance lead for the External Supply team, owning Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Deviation and Change Controls, training governance, inspection readiness support, and adherence to internal Amgen policies and global regulatory requirements. This role will require a close partnership with Amgen External Supply, Global / Regional / Site Supply Chain, Global Distribution, and External Quality.


AXP is a critical component of Amgen’s Global Supply Chain, responsible for enabling reliable, efficient, and agile planning and delivery operations for Amgen’s CMO\-sourced products. The Senior Associate, based at Amgen’s Hyderabad site, will be a key member of this team and a foundational contributor to the External Planning work center, supporting the business performance and continuous improvement of planning operations. The role requires strong knowledge of GMP environments, document management systems, and cross\-functional collaboration within a highly regulated biopharmaceutical supply chain.

**Responsibilities:**

*Compliance \& SOP Governance*

* Own and manage all team SOPs (GMP and non\-GMP), work instructions, and guiding documents.
* Lead periodic SOP reviews, revisions, and lifecycle management in alignment with Amgen quality systems.
* Ensure alignment of team procedures with global policies, regulatory requirements, and CMO oversight standards.
* Coordinate cross\-functional reviews and approvals of procedural documents.
* Maintain document control and ensure inspection readiness at all times.
* Monitor and report performance metrics (e.g., cycle time, aging, on\-time closure); escalate overdue items.
* Monitor and report (SOP, training, regulatory commitments, deviations and change management) trending and provide leadership with insights and action plans for improvement.

*Training Management*

* Own and track all team training requirements (GMP and non\-GMP).
* Manage training completion, driving closure of overdue items.
* Partner with Quality and HR to ensure accurate training curricula and assignment.
* Develop training materials and support onboarding of new team members.
* Prepare compliance dashboards and periodic status reports.

*Regulatory \& Audit Support*

* Support internal and external audits and inspections related to External Supply operations and documentation practices.
* Track and manage compliance commitments, CAPAs, and action items for the team.
* Ensure proper documentation and archival of audit\-related records.
* Partner with Quality Assurance to ensure inspection readiness across the External Planning function.

*Deviation \& Change Control Management*

* Own and manage deviations and change control records across AXP supply chain operations.
* Ensure timely initiation, routing, and closure in accordance with procedures and timelines.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant records within quality systems.
* Support workflow execution through coordination, tracking, and documentation updates.
* Ensure audit readiness with complete, accurate, and inspection\-ready records.

*Continuous Improvement*

* Monitor adherence to established procedures and identify compliance gaps.
* Drive process improvements to simplify documentation, training tracking, and governance workflows.
* Support risk assessments and change management activities impacting External Planning.

*Key Skills \& Competencies*

* Strong attention to detail and compliance mindset
* High level of ownership and accountability
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Proactive problem\-solving skills
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills

**What we expect of you**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a leader with these qualifications.

**Basic Qualifications:**
-------------------------

* Any degree and 5\-9 years’ supply chain experience in GMP\-regulated pharmaceutical / biotechnology industry, or related business fields


In addition to meeting above requirements, you must have at least 2 years’ experience working in teams, projects, and programs. This experience may run concurrently with the required GMP\-regulated experience referenced above.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience in Supply Chain, External Manufacturing, or Quality within a GMP environment.
* Strong knowledge of GMP documentation practices and quality systems.
* Experience managing SOPs and document control systems.
* Familiarity with document management systems and training compliance tracking.
* Experience supporting audits or regulatory inspections.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to operate independently while partnering cross\-functionally.
* Proficiency in MS Office and document management systems.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist II
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist II
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Job responsibilities**  

* In conjunction with all of Talent Acquisition, creates a deep and diverse talent pool to service resourcing requirements across multiple business units.
* Collaborates directly with hiring managers to understand business and skill set requirements to build a comprehensive strategic hiring plan by setting the vision, strategy, and goals to ensure current and future resource demands are met.
* As a strategic partner to your hiring managers, provide expertise in market insights, talent landscape, and an understanding of talent needs to establish expectations and build a collaborative approach with your customers to meet demands.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing regular updates to hiring managers and setting expectations on the hiring process per requisition or department, or both, as required.
* Utilize appropriate sourcing channels (including applicant tracking system, candidate relationship management system, job boards, advertising, networking, employee referral program) to identify qualified candidates.
* Monitor recruitment sourcing methods and provide recommendations to improve applicant attraction. Suggests innovative solutions to sourcing challenges and competitive intelligence from those efforts.
* Offers creative solutions to sourcing hard to fill requisitions in collaboration with the business.
* Responsible to manage full cycle recruiting process to include but not limited to: complete initial screening interview of potential candidates and reject non\-relevant applications, prepare candidate profile for hiring manager following interview screen, submit short listed candidates to hiring managers for review, conducts candidate debrief session after interviews are completed and extends verbal offers of employment to successful candidates.
* Ensures data accuracy within Applicant Tracking System.
* Initiates and maintains open communication with hiring managers and Human Resources (HR) colleagues in meeting recruiting needs.
* May create collateral HR materials for trade shows, professional organization meetings, and career fairs. May attend trade shows, professional organization meetings and career fairs.
* May provide training and coaching activities for Talent Acquisition Specialists.
* Performs other job\-related duties as assigned
**Qualifications \- External**

**What we’re looking for**  

Basic Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* Experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter in a corporate or agency environment
* Proven track record in direct sourcing and managing an end\-to\-end recruiting process required
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to think and influence strategically
* Proven track record in utilizing creative recruitment techniques and measurement of results
* Ability to work well with multi\-functional team and with all levels within organization
* Strong problem solving, influencing, negotiating, facilitating and partnership skills required
* Ability to effectively engage and build relationships with line management, employees, and HR team at all levels
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines
* Strong time management skills and able to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong customer services skills
* Strong attention to detail and an ability to maintain confidentiality
Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience as a full cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter supporting a CRO or in the Pharmaceutical industry
* Experience working in Workday
* Experience with a CRM
**Get to know Syneos Health**

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.  

  



http://www.syneoshealth.com

title: Recruitment Coordinator (On Contract)
description:
Role Description:

As a Recruitment Coordinator at Booking Holdings India (Center of Excellence), you’ll be a key enabler of a seamless, high\-impact recruiting experience. You’ll partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and external stakeholders to manage interview coordination, candidate communication, and recruitment logistics across multiple time zones.

  

This role calls for strong operational rigor, attention to detail, and a passion for delivering outstanding candidate and stakeholder experiences. You’ll play a critical role in supporting our Talent Acquisition efforts, while also contributing to process enhancements, employer brand initiatives, and recruitment events.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end\-to\-end interview coordination including scheduling, logistics, communication with candidates, and interviewer support across time zones.
* Act as the primary point of contact for candidates and interviewers throughout the interview process, ensuring clarity and a high\-touch experience.
* Ensure all candidate and interview\-related information is tracked accurately across systems (e.g., iCIMS, Workday, Google Suite).
* Manage logistics for in\-person and virtual interviews, including executive\-level sessions and technical setups (Zoom, Skype, Lifesize, etc.).
* Partner with recruiters on job postings, initial screening, and process documentation when needed.
* Support employer branding initiatives and recruitment events (e.g., job fairs, meetups, diversity events) in coordination with the Events team.
* Actively contributes to enhancing talent acquisition and onboarding processes, driving team efficiency and ensuring a consistently exceptional candidate experience.
* Manages end\-to\-end candidate travel logistics for both domestic and international interviews, including visa documentation and reimbursement of expenses.
* Seamlessly manages multiple candidate schedules on a daily basis, including high\-volume Sprint Days, ensuring all interviews are well\-coordinated and executed with precision.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve scheduling workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and streamline the candidate experience.
* Lead the complete offer management process \& work in partnership with the recruitment team \& HR Ops team.
* Work in conjunction with offered candidates to understand their perspective and take them along in pre\-onboarding journey

**Requirements/Experience**

* 5\+ years of proven experience in recruitment coordination or talent operations within dynamic, high\-volume, and fast\-paced environments.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and multitasking skills with a high level of attention to detail.
* Proactive and solution\-focused, with a strong sense of ownership and the initiative to drive operational excellence.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to craft professional messages and build rapport with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Tech\-savvy with experience using applicant tracking systems (e.g., iCIMS) and collaboration tools (Google Suite, Zoom).
* Resilient and adaptable; thrives in high\-pressure situations and remains agile in the face of shifting priorities.
* Team player with a collaborative mindset, yet confident working independently.
* Strong understanding of the talent acquisition lifecycle and passion for delivering exceptional candidate experiences.
* Ability to manage sensitive information with discretion and maintain confidentiality.
* Possesses strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and apply insights to drive creative, effective solutions.
* Willingness to support occasional after\-hours events as needed.
* Deep passion for talent acquisition and thrives in a collaborative, close\-knit team environment.
* Self\-assured, proactive, and energized by fast\-paced, constantly evolving settings.
* Brings a positive, engaging presence to the workplace, with a great sense of fun and a contagious enthusiasm that uplifts the team.

**What You Bring \- Personality \& Professional Presence**

* Driven, energetic, and highly motivated, hands\-on in execution while thinking strategically about talent.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to craft compelling conversations that capture and engage the interest of top talent.
* Highly articulate; adept at conveying complex ideas and engaging senior stakeholders with clarity, professionalism, and influence.
* Balances tenacity with emotional intelligence, knows when to persist and when to pivot.
* Self\-assured, composed under pressure, and quick on their feet in dynamic situations.
* Naturally outgoing and personable; enjoys connecting with people from diverse backgrounds and functions.
* Curious by nature, with a genuine desire to learn, grow, and stay ahead of trends.
* Demonstrates executive presence and is confident in navigating interactions with senior leaders.
* Strong commercial awareness with a solid understanding of business models, performance metrics, and industry dynamics, able to draw insights and communicate them effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

description:
About the Opportunity
  
The Services Consultant is responsible for all phases of a new client coming onto Dayforce’s system or an existing client upgrading to a new Dayforce processing product. They work in a project team to provide clients with effective solutions that are aligned to our commitment of reliable, repeatable and quality implementation practices.
  
  

What you'll get to do
  
* Ability to translate business process requirements into configuration requirements for the Dayforce Solution purchased with differing levels of complexity.
* Will work in conjunction with Project Manager and Project Team in the completion of an implementation.

* Ability to consult customer on business needs
* Ability to engage with multiple projects \& customers at the same time and manage priorities accordingly
* Excellent organization, communication, and collaboration skills
* Ability to lead and facilitate customer workshops and sessions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Prior functional experience with Dayforce HCM would be an asset
* Prior consultative experience with employee data integration or HCM software
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, IT, or any IT related field
* 2\-5 years’ of HCM consulting experience with an HCM software provider preferably with a focus on core modules (WFM, Payroll and/or Core HR)

* Analytical thinking is required
* Excellent documentation skills
* Superior customer support experience
* Experience working with North American clients and vendors a benefit

-----------------------------------

* Identify opportunities to improve payroll efficiency, automation, and accuracy.
* Participate in payroll system implementation, updates, and global process improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to cross\-training efforts and support APAC payroll processing when required

* 2–3 years of hands\-on payroll processing experience within India or APAC countries.
* Experience within a multinational or shared service environment is an advantage.
* Proven experience working with payroll vendors (e.g., ADP, BSR \& Co., KPMG, or equivalent).

* Strong understanding of Indian payroll legislation and statutory requirements.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced formulas, reconciliation, analysis).

We believe you’ll find working with us both rewarding and exciting. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute and work alongside talented colleagues in a collaborative environment.

title: Variable Compensation Associate
description:
**About this role:**

The Variable Compensation Associate plays a crucial role within our VC Care team, supporting the administration of worldwide Sales, Consulting, Conference, and Specialist Compensation Plans. You will assist commission\-eligible associates with compensation\-related inquiries, disputes, and escalations, provide education and training on compensation details, and perform recurring monthly processes as well as ad\-hoc reporting and analysis regarding bookings data, revenue performance, commission earnings, and annual sales awards attainment. This position requires strong analytical skills, exceptional customer service, and proficiency in Excel.


**What you'll do:**

* Complete recurring manual tasks for processes not systematically automated, frequent use of Excel, SQL, and SaaS commission applications
* Maintain commission application by performing data inputs, validation, and data quality checks on both imports and exports
* Assist commission\-eligible associates with inquiries related to commission, compensation, quota, earnings, and related topics via multiple channels (email, chat, etc.)
* Engage with Sales Associates to explain and support their understanding of commission calculations, adjustments, and payments
* Conduct thorough research and analysis to resolve inquiries, investigating anomalies to determine root causes and propose solutions
* Review monthly commission payments, confirm calculations by reconciling data to source systems, and sign\-off on payment integrity
* Process adjustment requests according to established documentation
* Generate ad\-hoc sales reports and analyses for leadership and business partners as needed
* Deliver formal and ad\-hoc training sessions to commission\-eligible associates
* Collaborate and coordinate among financial, sales, and operational departments
* Participate in testing system enhancements as required
* Drive continuous improvement by supporting initiatives, taking ownership of responsibilities, and meeting department SLAs, goals, and objectives
* Coordinate and complete additional projects as requested

**What you'll need:**

* 1 year of relevant experience, professional development, relevant college coursework, or specialized certifications
* Proficiency in basic Excel functions including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, data filtering and sorting, and strong data analytical skills
* Understanding of SQL, basic query writing, and use of pre\-written templates is a plus
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, effective listening skills, and the ability to support a high volume of inquiries in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong problem\-solving skills, curious mindset, and ability to resolve complex inquiries with available resources
* Comfortable working with large data sets from multiple sources
* Ability to understand compensation plan elements
* Flexibility and adaptability to manage ambiguity, unexpected changes, and foster continuous improvement
* Willingness to take initiative and accept new projects proactively
* Excellent organization and time management skills
* Motivated, high\-potential performer, with a self\-starter attitude
* Strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills
* Able to solve complex problems and successfully manage ambiguity and unexpected change
* Teachable and embracing of best practices and feedback as a means of continuous improvement
* Consistent high achiever marked by perseverance, humility, and a positive outlook in the face of challenges

**What you'll get:**

In addition to an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential, Gartner associates enjoy exceptional compensation and benefits, including:


* An upbeat, positive culture. Integrity, objectivity, collaboration, results, and a no\-limits mindset are central to our values
* Limitless growth. We work with you to help you meet your goals and advance within the company
* Encouragement to be innovative and challenge status quo
* Exposure to industry leading training and development
* Performance based recognition and rewards

**Who are we?**

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.


Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.


Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.


**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.


We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.


Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.


We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.


It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.


**What do we offer?**

Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.


In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.


Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

The role acts as a process expert and first line of governance, working closely with HR Operations, Payroll Vendors, HRBPs, and upstream teams to ensure clean, validated inputs Own and execute daily and cycle\-based pre\-payroll activities across assigned regions (NA / EMEA), ensuring adherence to defined cut\-offs. Validate and reconcile new hires, terminations, job changes, compensation changes, one\-time payments, bonus/commission inputs, and LOA payments Perform resolved\-vs\-system reconciliation to ensure all approved transactions are accurately reflected prior to payroll lock. Deep understanding of pre\-payroll controls, reconciliations, and cut\-off management. Proven ability to manage high\-volume, time\-critical transactions with zero\-defect mindset. Preferred

Deep understanding of pre\-payroll controls, reconciliations, and cut\-off management. Proven ability to manage high\-volume, time\-critical transactions with zero\-defect mindset. Preferred Experience supporting multi\-country or regional payrolls (NA / EMEA). Exposure to payroll vendor coordination (ADP or equivalent). Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrates ownership and accountability for payroll readiness. Proactively flags risks and drives closure before payroll lock. Acts as a process authority and mentor for junior team members. Communicates clearly with senior stakeholders under tight timelines.


  

Any Graduation

title: Talent Intelligence & Research Specialist
description:
What You'll Do:

This role drives talent intelligence and strategic sourcing for hard\-to\-fill and niche talent by combining market research, proactive sourcing, and data\-driven insights to build strong candidate pipelines. It also helps scale recruiting impact across Avalara by developing AI\-driven tools, refining sourcing strategy, and sharing market intelligence that strengthens our talent approach and employer value proposition.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be:
* Conduct market mapping and talent research to identify target companies, talent pools, and market trends.
* Source and engage passive candidates for hard\-to\-fill and niche roles, assess initial fit, and deliver qualified candidate slates.
* Build and maintain pipelines for key and hard\-to\-fill roles, using data to refine sourcing strategies and partnering closely with Recruitment Marketing to strengthen talent attraction efforts.
* Conduct global and regional talent research to identify talent availability, market trends, and strategic location opportunities that support the company’s business model and evolving talent needs.
* Develop and deploy AI\-driven tools that enable recruiters and talent teams to scale talent research, market intelligence, and sourcing.
* Create analytical models that continuously inform talent personas, outreach strategies, and intelligence on the most effective sources of talent, helping refine and evolve sourcing strategy over time.
* Proactively share talent market insights that help our team stay informed on evolving skill trends, shifting market dynamics, and emerging signals to watch, so we can better position Avalara as an employer of choice.


What You'll Need to be Successful:
* 8\+ years of combined experience in recruiting, sourcing, and research, ideally in hard\-to\-fill or niche talent areas across multiple regions
* Naturally curious and highly analytical, with the ability to synthesize large amounts of information into clear insights to drive practical recommendations
* Strong experience in market mapping, talent intelligence, and research\-driven sourcing strategy
* Familiarity with recruiting technologies, sourcing channels, and data analytics tools; experience with AI\-enabled solutions is required
* Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with proven ability to engage passive candidates and build interest in opportunities


Avalara is an AI\-first Company:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


How We'll Take Care of You:

Total Rewards


In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

  

Health \& Wellness  

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.  

Inclusive culture and diversity  

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.  


What You Need To Know About Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.  

We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.  

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too. **We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Executive Director Technology Recruitment
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

Join our dynamic Talent Acquisition team as a Recruiting Professional, where you'll utilize your expertise in the banking or financial services industry to attract and engage top\-tier candidates.




**Job Summary**


As a Executive Director in Global Technology, you will play a critical role in attracting, sourcing and recruiting top talent, managing the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle for Technology, Product and Data roles and providing strategic talent acquisition solutions.


You will focus on experienced hire roles across the Technology, Product and Data, with positions ranging from Analyst to Executive Director. In addition to working on open roles, you will engage in ongoing candidate development and presentation, as well as opportunistic candidate engagement. Your role will also encompass supporting all aspects of Talent Acquisition \& Talent Management for Global Technology, including competitive intelligence, market mapping, succession planning, and confidential project work. The ability to foster strong client relationships with senior managers and candidates is essential, and your consultative, strategic thought leadership will be key to your success.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end, full life cycle recruitment, from direct approach to completion.
* Conduct requirement intake calls with hiring managers, offering guidance on recruitment processes, controls, and policies.
* Evaluate, interview, and present qualified candidates to hiring managers, refining recruiting strategies based on feedback.
* Serve as a subject matter expert, influencing decision\-making and effectively managing hiring manager and candidate expectations.
* Educate candidates on career growth potential, benefits, compensation philosophy, and the advantages of employment, ensuring successful offer closures.
* Develop and implement diversity strategies, educating hiring managers to present a diverse candidate slate.
* Provide meaningful market data to support client needs.
* Manage a team of 3 to 4 members.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Relevant experience with full life cycle recruiting in a fast\-paced corporate environment or search firm.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage complex assignments and multiple searches while delivering exceptional client service.
* Excellent relationship management skills with both clients and candidates.
* High comfort level with direct sourcing and the ability to engage currently employed candidates.
* Knowledge of executive compensation packages across different competitors and industries, with the ability to negotiate complex compensation deals.




**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Prior experience working in a search firm, combined with corporate experience.


**ABOUT US**  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world’s most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  


Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we’re setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.  

  

Human Resources plays a critical role in driving the employee experience, shaping the firm’s culture and building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are a strategic partner to the business — working with leaders across the firm to hire, develop and retain the best people and help meet business goals. Together, we foster a work environment in which our people are supported, feel like they belong and are able to make an impact through their work. We develop and deliver a suite of products and services that help make JPMorgan Chase an employer of choice and drive our business forward.

**Description**


Talent Acquisition Specialist II
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Job responsibilities**  

* In conjunction with all of Talent Acquisition, creates a deep and diverse talent pool to service resourcing requirements across multiple business units.
* Collaborates directly with hiring managers to understand business and skill set requirements to build a comprehensive strategic hiring plan by setting the vision, strategy, and goals to ensure current and future resource demands are met.
* As a strategic partner to your hiring managers, provide expertise in market insights, talent landscape, and an understanding of talent needs to establish expectations and build a collaborative approach with your customers to meet demands.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing regular updates to hiring managers and setting expectations on the hiring process per requisition or department, or both, as required.
* Utilize appropriate sourcing channels (including applicant tracking system, candidate relationship management system, job boards, advertising, networking, employee referral program) to identify qualified candidates.
* Monitor recruitment sourcing methods and provide recommendations to improve applicant attraction. Suggests innovative solutions to sourcing challenges and competitive intelligence from those efforts.
* Offers creative solutions to sourcing hard to fill requisitions in collaboration with the business.
* Responsible to manage full cycle recruiting process to include but not limited to: complete initial screening interview of potential candidates and reject non\-relevant applications, prepare candidate profile for hiring manager following interview screen, submit short listed candidates to hiring managers for review, conducts candidate debrief session after interviews are completed and extends verbal offers of employment to successful candidates.
* Ensures data accuracy within Applicant Tracking System.
* Initiates and maintains open communication with hiring managers and Human Resources (HR) colleagues in meeting recruiting needs.
* May create collateral HR materials for trade shows, professional organization meetings, and career fairs. May attend trade shows, professional organization meetings and career fairs.
* May provide training and coaching activities for Talent Acquisition Specialists.
* Performs other job\-related duties as assigned
**Qualifications \- External**

**What we’re looking for**  

Basic Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* Experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter in a corporate or agency environment
* Proven track record in direct sourcing and managing an end\-to\-end recruiting process required
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to think and influence strategically
* Proven track record in utilizing creative recruitment techniques and measurement of results
* Ability to work well with multi\-functional team and with all levels within organization
* Strong problem solving, influencing, negotiating, facilitating and partnership skills required
* Ability to effectively engage and build relationships with line management, employees, and HR team at all levels
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines
* Strong time management skills and able to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong customer services skills
* Strong attention to detail and an ability to maintain confidentiality

Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience as a full cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter supporting a CRO or in the Pharmaceutical industry
* Experience working in Workday
* Experience with a CRM
**Get to know Syneos Health**


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

  

http://www.syneoshealth.com

**Additional Information**


Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

* Develops a shared vision and mission with team and stakeholders
* Educates business on the recruiting process
* Knows when to escalate issues to achieve common organization goal.

* Takes steps to perform work at a high level in order to achieve goals "demonstrates a high level of effort to complete work to agreed standards " works outside the limits of own job when necessary to achieve results " seeks feedback and modifies own behavior and approach to improve performance

Wherever you are in the amazing world of Disney, you are contributing to the stories of our iconic brands, recognized by audiences everywhere for entertainment, information and inspiration. Innovation, imagination and inclusion are at the core of Disney, defining the experience that we deliver as well as providing the foundation of our success. The Sr Recruiter, Talent Acquisition is responsible for recruiting top talent and delivering excellent service to technology clients for The Walt Disney Company, Bangalore India team.

  

This individual will develop robust candidate pipelines and be capable of generating results in a fast\-paced environment. This professional will also be directly responsible for the full\-service client management and recruiting of our technology and engineering disciplines.

  

The Sr Recruiter, Talent Acquisition will partner with the stakeholders to execute recruiting strategies. The ideal candidate will possess the ability to proactively identify top level talent through a variety of sourcing/recruiting techniques. * Lead and drive the end\-to\-end recruitment process; including source, attract, interview, selection of high\-quality candidates against defined criteria.
* Demonstrate ability to attract, influence and convert hard to find passive talent through your understanding of the business and employee value proposition
* Drive the development and implementation of comprehensive technical recruitment plans
* Collaborate with clients and HR partners to develop a strong understanding of department culture, business strategy and talent profiles to deliver on the hiring needs of the business
* Conduct in\-depth screens and assess potential technical candidates for level of interest, qualifications and compensation
* Use innovative sourcing and marketing/branding techniques to engage both active and passive candidates.
* Utilize recruitment Applicant tracking system and CRM etc. for workflow tracking, communication and management of active and passive candidates
* Ongoing research of competitive landscape and market insights/trends to remain current and relevant in functional technology expertise and demographics
* Drive facilitation of continuous improvement via measurement tools, scorecards, and recruitment analytics
* Participate in special projects/task forces as assigned
* Represent Company for recruiting purposes at identified networking and industry events, job fairs, conferences, etc.
* Develop a broad professional network of top technology talent

 **Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 4\+ years of large corporate and agency technology recruiting experience, across various technical disciplines, including software engineering, system architecture, data services and all related functional software and services professionals
* Experience meeting time to fill, quantity, quality, diversity and internal hiring
* Deep experience using social media tools for sourcing and branding efforts
* Expertise in advanced Boolean and/or Semantic searching
* Proven ability to support/interact and advise senior level management
* Ability to analyze job descriptions and candidate profiles to determine target profile needs and appropriate match
* Experience in a role where multiple projects and competing demands are the norm
* Excellent consultative skills and proven success developing strong, collaborative relationships across multiple departments and levels
* Proven experience engaging high\-potential prospects through targeted sourcing and cold calling

title: Junior Executive - HR
description:
**Position Overview**

The Junior Executive – Human Resources is an entry\-to\-mid level position based at the Head Office. The incumbent will work closely with the HR Manager and the broader HR team to support the full spectrum of HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, employee records management, payroll coordination, performance management, and compliance. This role provides excellent exposure to both the strategic and transactional dimensions of HR in a dynamic trading environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment**

* Coordinate end\-to\-end recruitment activities including drafting job postings, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and maintaining candidate pipelines for head office and store\-level roles.
* Liaise with department heads to understand manpower requirements and prepare requisition documentation.
* Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, job portals, and campus placement partners.
* Conduct initial telephonic/in\-person screening interviews for junior and mid\-level vacancies.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, and coordinate pre\-joining formalities.

**2\. Onboarding \& Induction**

* Facilitate structured onboarding programmes for new joiners, ensuring a smooth transition into the organisation.
* Coordinate induction schedules, prepare orientation materials, and liaise with IT, Admin, and Finance for new hire setup.
* Track probation periods and ensure timely confirmation reviews are conducted.

**3\. Employee Records \& HRIS Management**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records in the Human Resource Information System (HRIS) including personal data, employment history, leave balances, and documentation.
* Ensure timely filing and safekeeping of all physical and digital employee files in compliance with data protection policies.
* Generate periodic HR reports on headcount, attrition, absenteeism, and other key metrics for management review.

**4\. Payroll \& Attendance Coordination**

* Assist in monthly payroll processing by collating attendance data, leave records, overtime, and variable pay inputs from departments.
* Coordinate with Finance for payroll disbursement and resolve salary\-related queries from employees.
* Maintain accurate leave management records and administer the leave management system.

**5\. Performance Management**

* Support the annual and mid\-year performance appraisal cycle by circulating forms, tracking submissions, and maintaining appraisal records.
* Assist in preparing performance improvement plans (PIPs) documentation and follow\-up scheduling.
* Coordinate 360\-degree feedback collection and analysis as directed by the HR Manager.

**6\. Employee Relations \& Engagement**

* Serve as a first point of contact for employee queries related to HR policies, benefits, and procedures.
* Assist in planning and executing employee engagement initiatives, welfare programmes, team\-building events, and recognition activities.
* Support grievance handling processes by documenting complaints, scheduling hearings, and maintaining confidentiality.
* Assist in conducting exit interviews and compiling attrition analysis reports.

**7\. Training \& Development**

* Coordinate training needs identification (TNI) exercises in liaison with department heads.
* Organise internal and external training programmes including scheduling, logistics, vendor coordination, and post\-training feedback collection.
* Maintain a training calendar and track training hours, certifications, and skill development records.

**8\. Statutory Compliance \& HR Administration**

* Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable labour laws including the Shops \& Establishments Act, PF, ESI, gratuity, and other statutory requirements relevant to the footwear trading sector.
* Support audits and inspections by preparing required documentation and reports.
* Draft HR communications including notices, circulars, memos, and policy updates.
* Coordinate with legal counsel for documentation related to employment contracts and disciplinary matters.

**9\. General HR Administration**

* Maintain the HR department's filing systems, correspondence logs, and internal communication records.
* Support the HR team in special projects, policy reviews, and process improvement initiatives as assigned.
* Coordinate inter\-departmental HR activities between head office and branch/store locations.

**Qualifications \& Educational Requirements**

**Minimum Qualification**

Bachelor's Degree (B.Com, BBA, B.A. or equivalent)

**Preferred Qualification**

MBA / PGDM in Human Resources Management, or MSW (Master of Social Work) with HR specialisation

**Experience**

0–3 years of relevant HR experience. Freshers with strong academic records and internship experience are encouraged to apply.

**Certifications (Desirable)**

SHRM\-CP, HRCI, or any recognised HR certification; Working knowledge of labour law compliance

**Skills \& Competencies**

**Technical / Functional Skills**

* Working knowledge of HR processes including recruitment, payroll, and performance management.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) — Excel skills including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and basic data analysis are essential.
* Familiarity with HRIS platforms (e.g., SAP HCM, Darwinbox, Zoho People, GreytHR, or similar).
* Basic understanding of Indian labour laws including PF, ESI, Gratuity, Shops \& Establishments Act, and the Employment Exchange Act.
* Ability to draft professional HR communications, circulars, and policy documents.

**Behavioural / Soft Skills**

* Strong communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to interact effectively with employees across all levels.
* High degree of confidentiality, integrity, and professional ethics.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining records and preparing reports.
* Proactive, self\-motivated attitude with a willingness to learn and adapt.
* Team player with a collaborative approach to working within a cross\-functional environment.
* Empathy and interpersonal sensitivity when dealing with employee concerns and grievances.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Target**

Time\-to\-Fill (Recruitment)

≤ 30 working days per vacancy

Onboarding Completion Rate

100% within defined schedule

Payroll Input Accuracy

≥ 98% accuracy, zero payroll errors

Employee Query Resolution Time

≤ 48 hours for standard queries

Training Coordination

100% of planned programmes executed on schedule

HR Records Accuracy

Zero discrepancies in monthly HRIS audit

Compliance Documentation

100% statutory filings on time

Attrition Reporting

Monthly reports submitted within 5th of each month

**Working Conditions \& Benefits**

**Work Environment**

* Standard office environment at the Head Office.
* Five\-day working week with flexibility during peak recruitment or payroll cycles.
* Occasional travel to warehouse or retail store locations for HR audits, inductions, or employee engagement activities.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive fixed CTC commensurate with qualifications and experience.
* Performance\-linked variable pay reviewed annually.
* Statutory benefits: PF, ESI, Gratuity as applicable.
* Health insurance (self \+ dependents) and group life insurance.
* Paid annual leave, casual leave, and sick leave as per company policy.
* Staff purchase discount on company footwear brands.
* Access to learning and development programmes and external training sponsorships.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

description:
The Inventory Analyst is responsible for accurate daily stock entry and maintenance in ERP systems (Posist / Odoo) for FG (Finished Goods), SFG (Semi Finished Goods), RM (Raw

Materials), and PM (Packaging Materials). The role focuses on data accuracy, stock reconciliation, documentation control, and coordination with warehouse and production teams to ensure system stock matches physical inventory.

Primary Responsibilities (ERP \& Stock Entry Focus)

* Ensure Daily inward and outward stock entry in ERP (Posist / Odoo).
* Maintain accurate records of FG, SFG, RM, and PM stock movements.
* Create and update GRN, Dispatch, Transfers, Production Entries, and Returns.
* Update batch numbers, expiry dates, item codes, and UOM correctly in system.
* Ensure no pending or backdated entries at end of each day.
* Perform daily / weekly stock reconciliation between physical and ERP stock.
* Generate basic stock and variance reports from ERP.
* Maintain proper documentation of invoices, challans, and stock transfer notes.
* Support cycle counts and monthly physical audits.
* Highlight stock mismatches, damages, and expiry risks to reporting manager.

Other Key Roles \& Responsibilities

* Coordinate with Production, Dispatch, and Warehouse teams for smooth stock flow.
* Assist in master data management (SKU codes, categories, UOM, vendor/product mapping).
* Track slow moving and near expiry items and inform seniors.
* Follow Inventory SOPs and compliance standards.
* Maintain data integrity and confidentiality at all times.
* Support internal and external audits by providing accurate system data.
* Ensure proper filing and record keeping of all inventory documents.
* Provide basic stock status inputs for planning when required.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of ERP systems (Posist / Odoo preferred).
* Basic MS Excel / Google Sheets knowledge.
* Good numerical ability and attention to detail.
* Understanding of basic warehouse and inventory processes.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Discipline in documentation and record keeping.

Qualifications \& Experience

* Graduate / Diploma in Commerce, Supply Chain, Operations, or related field.
* 1–2 years experience in inventory, warehouse, or data entry role.
* Freshers with ERP knowledge can also apply.

* Data Entry Accuracy %.
* Pending Entries at Day End.
* Stock Variance %.
* Audit Error Rate.
* Timely Report Submission.
* Master Data Accuracy.

title: Factory Manager
description:
**Role:** Factory Manager (Day Shift \& Night Shift)  
**Department:** Production  
**Location:** Factory (Mathura)  
**Reporting To:** Plant Head / Director / MD

Role Purpose

To ensure disciplined, efficient, and uninterrupted factory operations across shifts, with strong control over production, manpower, safety, and issue resolution, especially during sensitive operational situations.

Key Responsibilities1\. Production Management

* Ensure achievement of daily and monthly production targets
* Monitor line efficiency, output, and wastage
* Take immediate corrective actions in case of delays or breakdowns

2\. Manpower Management

* Ensure labour attendance, discipline, and productivity
* Handle worker concerns proactively to prevent escalation
* Coordinate with HR for grievances, absenteeism, and conflicts
* Maintain accountability across shifts

3\. Shift Operations Management

* Ensure smooth shift handover with proper communication
* Avoid production loss during shift transitions
* Maintain continuity of operations between day and night shifts

4\. Crisis and Situation Handling

* Act as the first point of control during disputes or disruptions
* Prevent production stoppage due to mismanagement
* Escalate critical issues to management in a timely manner

5\. Quality and Compliance

* Ensure adherence to quality standards
* Maintain hygiene, safety, and compliance on the shop floor
* Prevent production\-related customer complaints

6\. Cross\-functional Coordination

* Coordinate with Purchase, Logistics, HR, and Maintenance
* Ensure material availability and dispatch alignment

KRAs (Key Result Areas)1\. Production Efficiency and Target Achievement

* Consistent achievement of production targets
* Reduction in downtime and wastage

2\. Workforce Discipline and Stability

* Controlled and disciplined workforce
* Minimal conflicts and disruptions

3\. Shift Management Effectiveness

* Seamless shift handovers
* No production variance due to poor coordination

4\. Crisis Prevention and Control

* Early identification of risks
* Effective handling of labour and operational issues

5\. Quality and Compliance Adherence

* Maintenance of product quality standards
* Compliance with safety and hygiene norms

6\. Coordination and Reporting

* Effective inter\-department coordination
* Timely and accurate reporting to management

KPIs (Key Performance Indicators)1\. Production KPIs

* Percentage achievement of daily production targets
* Line efficiency percentage
* Downtime hours per shift

2\. Manpower KPIs

* Labour attendance percentage
* Absenteeism and attrition rate
* Number of labour complaints or escalations

3\. Discipline KPIs

* Number of incidents (conflicts, stoppages)
* Issue resolution turnaround time

4\. Shift KPIs

* Shift handover error count
* Production variance between day and night shifts

5\. Quality KPIs

* Rejection percentage
* Number of production\-related customer complaints
* Batch failure rate

6\. Crisis Management KPIs

* Number of escalations to senior management
* Response time for critical issues

Day vs Night Shift Role ClarityDay Shift Factory Manager

* Production planning and scheduling
* Coordination with HR, Purchase, Logistics, and Maintenance
* Labour engagement and issue prevention
* Material readiness and vendor coordination
* Daily reporting and review

Night Shift Factory Manager

* Execution of production plan
* Maintaining discipline on the shop floor
* Immediate handling of issues during shift
* Escalation only in critical cases
* Maintaining logs for next\-day review

Mandatory Control Systems

* Shift Handover Register
* Record production status, issues, and labour concerns
* Daily Reporting System
* Production, manpower, and incident reporting
* Authority Clarity
* Factory Managers must have defined decision\-making authority on the shop floor

title: Associate Manager - SO
description:
**Job Description** **Job Summary**


The Associate Manager – Statistical Operations leads end‑to‑end statistical and analytical operations supporting **RMS and OMNI business planning and decision‑making**. The role ensures high‑quality forecasting, **universe‑level trend tracking, KPI validation, and Store \& Sample Maintenance**, along with overall operational rigor using internal, syndicated, and panel data.


This role partners closely with **Analytics, Data Science, Sourcing, Transformation \& Enablement, Business, Technology, and People (HR)** teams to deliver reliable statistical outcomes while fostering strong team collaboration and associate development.

**Statistical Operations**

* Own end‑to‑end statistical operations across forecasting and analytics workflows, including data intake, validation, model inputs, output reviews, and downstream hand‑offs.
* Ensure **accurate, timely, and SLA‑compliant delivery** of forecasts, validated KPIs, universe metrics, and analytical outputs across RMS and OMNI processes.
* Monitor and assess **universe‑level trends** to ensure stability, consistency, and alignment across time periods and data sources.
* Perform **KPI validation and data health checks**, ensuring completeness, reasonability, and adherence to defined statistical standards.
* Lead **Store \& Sample Maintenance processes**, including store and sample additions, removals, corrections, alignment, and ongoing universe maintenance.
* Ensure store‑ and sample‑level data integrity through regular validation, reconciliation, and impact assessments on forecasts and KPIs.
* Leverage **panel and syndicated data** to support forecasting, universe trend analysis, KPI validation, and statistical measurements.
* Support analytical enablement for **new initiatives, pilots, and ongoing programs** requiring statistical support or model updates.
* Manage historical and ongoing updates such as **universe restatements, store/sample maintenance updates, trend adjustments, and KPI corrections**, with strong governance and documentation.
* Review and validate statistical methodologies, assumptions, and outputs to ensure consistency across datasets, models, stores/samples, and time horizons.
* Conduct forecast and KPI performance reviews and drive continuous stability and accuracy improvement initiatives.
* Lead and contribute to **cross‑functional analytical projects** aimed at strengthening statistical processes and operational efficiency.
* Drive **automation and process optimization** initiatives to reduce manual effort, improve scalability, and enhance data reliability.
* Partner with **Analytics, Data Science, and Transformation \& Enablement teams** to transition pilots into BAU operations.

**Tools \& Systems**

* Hands‑on experience with **R, Python, SQL, and Advanced Excel**.
* Familiarity with **enterprise forecasting, planning, or analytics platforms** and data warehouse environments.
* Exposure to **automation, scripting, or workflow optimization** initiatives is preferred.

  

**Qualifications**  

* **8–10 years of progressive experience** in statistical operations, forecasting, analytics, or decision science roles, preferably within **FMCG / CPG, Retail, or Consumer Analytics** environments.
* Proven experience supporting **business planning, demand forecasting, or performance analytics** in large‑scale or matrixed organizations.
* Demonstrated exposure to **panel and syndicated data** used for demand forecasting, causal analysis, and trend interpretation.
* Experience working with **retailer‑level data**, including promotions, pricing, assortment changes, store coverage, and distribution dynamics.
* Prior experience operating in **production / BAU analytical environments** with defined SLAs, governance, and recurring delivery cycles.

  

**Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)
