Job Description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

**Role**

The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery


**͏**
-----

**Do**

* Delivery Management
* Ensure seamless delivery of the projects
* Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement
* Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs

  

* Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
* Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
* Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
* Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
* Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
* Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
* Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
* Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
* Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
* Client Relationship Management
* Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients

\- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
* Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
* Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
* Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
* Delivery governance across the project
* Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
* Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
* Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
* Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
* Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
* Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks
**͏**
-----

* Operational Excellence
* Automation Focus
* Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
* Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery

  

* Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
* Innovation Focus
* Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
* Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
* Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
* Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing
* Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
* Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
* Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
* Demand forecasting in line with business requirements
* Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

  

* Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
* Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
* Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
* Fresher engagement program
* Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
* Team Management
* Resourcing
* Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
* Hire adequate and right resources for the team
* Talent Management
* Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
* Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization

  

* Manage team attrition
* Drive diversity in leadership positions
* Performance Management
* Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
* Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
* Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
* Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
* Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
* Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
**͏**
-----

Deliver  



  

1\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ Client satisfaction
  

  

PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
  

  

2\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ operational efficiency
  

  

Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects
  

  

3\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ Financials
  

  

Revenue target achievement, Operating margin %, leakage from OB to revenue, revenue per employee, CR realization target, process exceptions to be minimized, bench cost % of total cost, underrun % target for FPP projects, effort saving through NG\-1, NG\-2 initiatives
  

  

5\.
  

  

Capability Building
  

  

% attrition, critical talent attrition%, % trained on new age skills, % of team trained in necessary behavioural skills, diversity ratio, % localization targets by market, billable rookie ratio, rookie/NJNB assimilation TATs, offshore mix
  

  

6\.
  

  

Team Management
  

  

Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score  

  



**͏**
-----

Mandatory Skills: Automotive .  

Experience: 8\-10 Years .

Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Lab Analyst – Water Testing
description:
**Job Title:** Lab Analyst – Building Material \& Water Testing  
**Location:** Noida Sector 64  
**Experience:** 6 Months – 1 Year  
**Job Type:** Full\-time \| **Joining:** Immediate Preferred

**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for a Lab Analyst to support testing of building materials and water samples in a NABL\-accredited laboratory. The role involves conducting tests, maintaining records, and ensuring compliance with IS and NABL standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform testing of cement, concrete, aggregates, steel, and water parameters (pH, TDS, BOD, COD)
* Maintain test records and assist in report preparation
* Follow QA/QC procedures and NABL guidelines
* Assist in calibration and maintenance of lab equipment
* Support documentation and audit requirements

**Requirements:**

* B.Sc / M.Sc in Chemistry / Environmental Science
* 6 months–1 year experience in NABL/testing lab preferred
* Basic knowledge of lab instruments and NABL documentation
* Good attention to detail

**Perks \& Benefits:**  
PF, Health Insurance, Life Insurance

**Note:** Immediate joiners preferred

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

description:
**Position \- Center Coordinator**

**Available Locations: Chandigarh** 

**Local Language Punjabi is Must**

**Major Responsibilities:**

* Offer Care/ Support to Kids/ Families staying at the Centre(s). This is the primary mission of Organisation.
* Ensure that all the SOPs pertaining to their center/ area are being followed.
* Emphasis will be on strictly following COVID\-19 precautions including proper wearing of Masks, Gloves, using Sanitizers, Hand Wash, maintaining Social Distancing, quarantine/ isolation (when needed), etc.
* Should greet/ offer water/ be courteous to all the Visitors/ Guests/ Donors who visit their center.
* Should wish and thank all the Visitors/ Guests/ Donors who visit their center.
* Take photos of the Visitors/ Guests/ Donors with the families/kids and upload/ send in the right groups.
* Maintain the Visitor register and send snapshots regularly.
* Shall assist as required in Volunteer programs and support Volunteers coming to their centers.
* Take care of their personal grooming – wear clean, neat clothes and be presentable when outside their residential units.
* Take special care that Hygiene practices at the center are followed at all times.
* Should ensure that there is no lapse in this responsibility.
* Should monitor that no Non\-Veg food is prepared/served at the center for the kids/ families and oneself. Also, no Alcohol/ Gutkha, intoxicant substances are allowed as these are strictly prohibited in the premises. The Centre Coordinators themselves should set an example for this so that others can follow the same. (Only boiled eggs for kids, based on the advice of treating doctors will be permitted)
* Centre (esp. washrooms) have to be kept clean and well maintained at all the time.
* Plan the schedule and supervise the House keeping staff who visit the centers for daily cleanliness. CC shall guide them and take responsibility, as required.
* Shall maintain, report and follow\-up for regular payments of Utility Bills/ Petty cash associated with the Centre they are in\-charge of.
* Shall maintain a record of the Monthly Height/ Weight of the kids at their center.
* Shall offer full support of giving information/ pictures/ details for case studies.
* Update the CM on the requirements of Ration/ Vegetables/ Fruits/ other items and handle inventory when received.
* Shall maintain the records, reports and handle distribution of grocery/ toiletries to all the families at the center.
* Shall maintain daily updated records of all the Empty/ Occupied Units at their center and report regularly as needed.
* Shall immediately report incidents/ issues by mail/ Wapp and/or telephone, of all significant occurrences at or outside their center and which are related to the families. Guidance on what all and how they have to be reported, will be offered by the reporting officers.
* Shall take pictures of Meal Mate programs and events conducted at their center.
* Shall be responsible for giving Toilet/ Hand wash/ Hygiene training to all the families at their center.
* Maintain a ready updated list of all emergency contacts like Police/ Fire brigade/ Doctor/ Ambulance/ Plumber/ Carpenter/ etc. That is displayed and easily available to all.
* Shall assist in safe upkeep, handling, and servicing of all equipment, products, water purifier, fridge, washing machine, TV, CCTV, firefighting equipment, etc.existing at the center.
* Assist in planning, organizing, follow\-up, etc. of all Organisations events/ programs/ activities
* Shall update and coordinate Hospital trips of the families. Facilitate their transport to hospitals in emergency situations, as per the policy.
* Shall assist in E\-Tours which shall be conducted regularly as per the guidance offered by reporting officers.
* Shall maintain a Temperature/ SpO2 Register for all the families, kids and themselves during the COVID\-19 situation.
* Shall supervise any activity taking place at the center including Pest control, internet, gas supply, other Services, visits of MCGM Officials, etc.
* Shall ensure confidentiality of all Organisations data, kids/ family information, pictures, financial information, official communication, etc. as mandated by Organisations policy.
* Handle any other work /task as assigned by the CM/ reporting officers/ management, from time to time.

**Reporting, Documentation, etc.**

* Prepare and maintain Visitors’ Log.
* Maintaining the Data for temperature, SpO2, etc. carried out daily.
* Maintain the Monthly Weight/ Height Data for all the kids present at their center.
* Manage inventory of groceries, toiletries, etc. at the center
* Duty Hours, Rest pauses and Meal breaks

**The Daily schedule of the Centre coordinators including Meal Breaks is as given below,**

From 6:30 am to 8:00 am on duty

From 8:00 am to 10:00 am off time

From 10:00 am to 14:00 pm on duty

From 14:00 pm to 16:00 pm off time (Lunch \+ Rest)

From 16:00 pm to 19:00 pm on duty (Visitors)

The above mentioned timings is subject to the situation at that particular center. It can

change as per the circumstances and the nature/ priority of work at hand.

**Weekly Off**

The Weekly off for Centre Coordinator will be a week day (not weekend) and is fixed.

They are required to follow the same schedule. Weekly Off means that they can take

the day off and can step outside the Centre but have to return back to the centre before

night fall. In their absence, a temporary arrangement will be made in regards to taking

the responsibility of that centre. In case of work Emergencies / Training / Official

meetings, etc. falling on their weekly off day, the same can be adjusted after getting

prior approval from the Centre Manager in consultation with the HR Department. Centre

Coordinators are required to apply through the Employee Leave application form to

adjust and avail of their weekly off and compensatory offs, as per laid out procedure.

title: PROCESS COORDINATOR
description:
**JOB SUMMARY** 

The Process Coordinator is a critical role within the Newage operating structure. This person is responsible for monitoring, tracking, and reporting on the day\-to\-day movement of company processes — ensuring that every system, tracker, and workflow assigned to them is running as it should.

Every business runs on processes. At Newage, these processes have to move every day — and someone has to make sure they do. The Process Coordinator is that person. They do not execute the work themselves. Instead, they watch the work, check the trackers, identify where things are on track and where they are not, and report clearly and on time — every single day.

A Process Coordinator may be assigned to one or more processes depending on the needs of the business. Their value lies in making sure nothing drifts, nothing falls silent, and no problem is missed before it causes damage. This is a role built on discipline, consistency, and attention to detail.

**Why This Role Matters**

1\. Processes only work when someone is actively watching them — every day.

2\. Problems are easiest to fix when caught early — not after the damage is done.

3\. Daily monitoring gives management a clear, real\-time picture of how the business is running.

4\. The Process Coordinator is the person who makes sure nothing important goes unnoticed.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 

1\. Monitor all assigned process trackers on a daily basis and confirm that each one is active, updated, and moving as expected.

2\. Complete and submit a clear daily monitoring report covering the status of every assigned process — what is on track, what is delayed, and what needs attention.

3\. Identify any process that has stopped, stalled, or is not being updated, and flag it immediately to the relevant team lead or manager.

4\. Track the movement of tasks across assigned workflows from start to completion, ensuring no task is left unresolved or unaccounted for without a clear reason.

5\. Coordinate with process owners and team members to follow up on outstanding items and confirm that pending actions have been completed.

6\. Maintain accurate records of daily monitoring activity so that management has a clear, reliable view of operational health at all times.

7\. Support the preparation of weekly and monthly process health summaries, highlighting recurring issues, patterns, or areas that need improvement.

8\. Ensure all trackers and reporting tools assigned to you are kept clean, current, and consistent — no outdated data, no missing entries.

9\. Escalate any issues that cannot be resolved at coordination level to the appropriate manager promptly and clearly.

10\. Participate in regular operations reviews and provide accurate, factual input on the status of the processes you are monitoring.

11\. Suggest improvements to tracking tools or reporting formats when a better or simpler method is identified.

12\. Adapt to new processes as the business grows — take on additional trackers or workflows as assigned and maintain the same standard of daily monitoring.

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 

1\. Graduate in any discipline

2\. Diploma holders with relevant experience will be considered

3\. Business administration or operations background is a plus — not a requirement Experience

1\. Freshers are welcome to apply

2\. Experience in coordination, operations, or admin is an advantage

3\. Prior use of trackers, checklists, or reporting tools is preferred

4\. Ability to work in a structured, process\-driven environment is essential

**SKILLS \& ABILITIES** 

1\. Clear written and verbal communication — able to report information accurately without confusion.

2\. Strong attention to detail — nothing is too small to check, and no entry is left unverified.

3\. Good time management — daily tasks are completed on schedule, every day.

4\. Ability to handle multiple trackers and processes simultaneously without losing track of any.

5\. Problem\-spotting ability — can identify when something is off, even before it becomes a bigger issue.

6\. Professional and consistent attitude — reliable, calm, and disciplined in daily output.

7\. Basic computer skills — comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, and digital reporting tools.

8\. Positive approach to feedback and learning — able to take direction and improve quickly.

**TOOLS \& TECHNOLOGY** 

The following tools are used regularly in this role:

**Tool / Platform Purpose**

Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets \- Daily tracker monitoring and data entry

Google Docs / Microsoft Word \- Writing and submitting daily monitoring reports

Company CRM / Internal Trackers \- Monitoring assigned processes and workflows

WhatsApp / Email \- Coordinating with team members and escalating issues

Google Drive / Shared Folders \- Storing and accessing reports and tracking files

**BENEFITS** 

1\. A structured role with clear daily responsibilities and defined growth pathways.

2\. Access to the Newage Learning Academy — continuous training and skill development.

3\. A supportive team environment where your work is visible and valued.

4\. Opportunity to grow into senior coordination or operations roles as the business expands.

5\. Exposure to a wide range of business processes, building strong operational knowledge over time.

description:

About the Company

Eythor Private Limited is a clean\-tech robotics startup developing AI\-powered, waterless solar panel cleaning and monitoring robots for rooftop and utility\-scale solar installations. We are working on robotics, embedded systems, IoT, automation, and renewable energy solutions.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Electronics Engineer who can support PCB design, embedded systems development, sensor integration, motor control, power electronics, and prototype testing for our solar panel cleaning robots. The candidate should be hands\-on, problem\-solving oriented, and interested in working on real hardware products.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and test electronic circuits for robotic systems.

* Program microcontrollers such as ESP32, STM32, Arduino, or similar platforms.
* Integrate sensors such as IR sensors, proximity sensors, current sensors, temperature sensors, limit switches, and LDR sensors.
* Develop and test motor driver circuits for DC/BLDC motors.
* Work on power supply, battery, charging, and protection circuits.
* Support IoT communication using Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, LoRa, or GSM modules.
* Troubleshoot electronics, wiring, PCB faults, and prototype issues.
* Coordinate with mechanical and software teams for complete robot integration.
* Prepare documentation, wiring diagrams, BOM, test reports, and assembly notes.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma / B.Tech / M.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, ECE, EEE, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or related field.
* Basic knowledge of electronics circuits, PCB design, embedded systems, and sensors.
* Freshers with strong practical project experience can apply.

Technical Skills

* PCB design: KiCad, EasyEDA, Altium, Eagle, or similar.
* Microcontrollers: ESP32, STM32, Arduino, AVR, or similar.
* Programming: Embedded C / Arduino IDE / STM32CubeIDE.
* Motor drivers, relays, MOSFETs, voltage regulators, SMPS, and protection circuits.
* Soldering, multimeter, oscilloscope, power supply, and debugging tools.

Preferred Experience

* Robotics, automation, IoT, solar, EV, battery systems, or embedded product development.
* Experience in prototype building, testing, and field troubleshooting.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their resume, project portfolio, and previous PCB/embedded work samples to: **Recruitment.eythor@gmail.com**

This is a hands\-on leadership role suited to someone who enjoys building processes, negotiating with suppliers, and growing a travel business.

Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI.  We are looking for a proactive and energetic HR Intern to support our day\-to\-day recruitment activities. This role is perfect for someone who wants to kick\-start their career in HR, enjoys interacting with people, and thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Additional information:** 
  

  

* Free Lunch \+ Snacks Daily

+ Exclusive project goodies


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!

**(Contractual Role)** 




  





**Role Purpose** 




 Build and institutionalize a strong analytics and workforce reporting backbone for Talent Acquisition. The role enables data‑led leadership decisions by translating hiring and workforce data into actionable insights across capacity planning, hiring effectiveness, cost optimization, and vendor governance. The incumbent will work closely with the TA Head, TA leadership, and recruiting teams across India to ensure consistent, accurate, and insight‑driven reporting.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



**1\. Hiring \& Workforce Analytics** 



* Design, automate, and maintain TA dashboards covering:
* Hiring WIP, ageing, offers, joiners, dropouts, and pending cases
* Open requisitions, sourcing mix, and turnaround time (TAT)
* Track end‑to‑end workforce movements:
* Active headcount, notice‑period employees, joiners, leavers, and dropouts
* Perform variance analysis against approved headcount and hiring plans
* Deliver analytics at firm, business unit, competency, and city levels



  





**2\. Leadership Reporting \& Insights** 



* Prepare monthly TA MIS, scorecards, and leadership decks for:
* TA Head and TA leadership / business review forums

**3\. Cost, Vendor \& Sourcing Analytics** 



* Track and analyze hiring costs including:
* Cost‑per‑hire, vendor costs, and internal vs. external sourcing mix
* YoY comparisons and trend analysis
* Assess vendor and sourcing channel performance:
* Productivity, conversion ratios, utilization, and ROI
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization and vendor rationalization
* Support TA budget planning and quarterly forecast revisions



  





**4\. Strategic, Governance \& Technology Enablement** 



* Support workforce planning exercises, compensation benchmarking inputs, and ad‑hoc studies led by the TA Head
* Track TA technology initiatives and ATS/ERP rollouts:
* Milestones, adoption metrics, and data governance indicators

**5\. Data Governance \& TA Collaboration** 



* Partner with recruiters, SPOCs, and TA operations to ensure:
* Data accuracy, timely updates, and reporting hygiene
* Standard definitions and a single source of truth
* Maintain confidentiality and compliance across all workforce and hiring data



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Accuracy, timeliness, and reliability of TA dashboards and reports

title: Talent Consultant
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Talent Consultant\- Senior Associate**
 If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career experience as a Talent Consultant in a high\-growth organization, we have a role here. At EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity, and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming, and belonging. We care for our business, society, and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 You will be responsible for supporting the Talent agenda for a business unit in EY GDS and will be the key point of contact for employees, counselors (managers) and business unit leadership on a range of talent\-related matters. You will drive and implement the engagement agenda, work closely with other members of the team to provide change leadership, increase workforce capability and talent management. You will build a deep understanding of business unit direction and Talent related topics/issues to ensure successful implementation of key projects and processes.
   

  

 You will need to be collaborative, influential, and work across functions to execute on attracting, assimilate, develop, engaging and retain key talent. You will drive project management for various HR (Human Resource) initiatives, including Workforce Planning, Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward \& Recognition etc
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Support the Strategic Talent Consultant in designing a sustainable and scalable engagement framework for the business unit and take ownership for the delivery
* Provide support to the business leaders and counsellors in the implementation of engagement initiatives across the business unit
* Anticipate issues and needs within the business unit and address these effectively
* Provide insight on people issues, particularly ER (Employee Relations) cases within business unit, provide a robust point of view on business decisions and their impact upon people
* Ensure that all necessary people management and development activity required to support the business unit is delivered in the most professional and effective manner
* Execute innovative HR programs
* Ensure resolution of HR related issues and handle these effectively within the given timeline, involving the Employee Relation Talent function where required or expected
* Facilitate change and support the implementation and successful adoption of special projects and initiatives in the business unit, for example: Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward exercises
* Ensure coordination between TCs team of various spans and consolidate inputs for leadership reviews and reporting
* Ensure compliance to local regulations and manage risks (e.g., performance management risk)


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, ability to develop clear, actionable plans in support of an overall business unit strategy
* Ability to engage and influence others, with good change management skills and a desire to act as a change agent
* Strong clients focus with the ability to build good relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
* Develop strong relationship with other Talent Centre of Excellence teams to ensure that centrally developed products and initiatives meet the requirements of the business unit
* Ability to interact with people on the floor and build strong relationships
* Self motivated and ability to think on the feet for managing talent initiatives at location level
* Ability to work with ambiguity and build consensus across diverse, often global, groups


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate or a post graduate qualification in a Business or Human Resource discipline is desirable.
* 2\-4 years of proven HR generalist experience (e.g., performance management, employee engagement, analysing employee metrics)
* Relevant working experience in delivering / managing talent initiatives


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience working in a consulting organization or in a similar professional services environment
* Experience of working in a cross\-border, virtual environment would be beneficial


**What We Look For**
* Keen interest to invest time for self\-learning, seeking opportunities to work on cross\-functional HR projects
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* A self\-starter, independent\-thinker, curious and creative person with desire and passion


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK (United Kingdom) – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We will introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

 The Global Mobility Support Officer plays a critical role in enabling seamless international assignments for employees, including senior executives, across DSM‑Firmenich. This role sits within the GES H2R shared services model and partners closely with regional HR teams and global vendors to ensure compliant, high‑quality, and efficient mobility services. * Support service delivery against defined SLAs, KPIs, and tier models while identifying opportunities for process and service improvements.

Job Title: Data Analyst (Treasury Mid office)
 



 Department: Treasury – Debt \& Lending Alliances
 



 Location: Propelld Corporate Office, HSR Bangalore
 



 Experience: Freshers
 



 Job Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**About Propelld:** 




 Propelld is a leading fintech NBFC focused on providing innovative financial solutions in the education sector. We are data\-driven, using cutting\-edge analytics to offer personalized loan products and services to our clients.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 We are seeking a skilled personnel for Treasury mid office / Data Analyst with 2\-3 years of experience, strong proficiency in Excel, and a solid understanding of financial numbers and treasury operations. The ideal candidate will gather, analyze, and present data\-driven insights to help optimize product offerings, streamline operations, and enhance the customer experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Perform data collection, cleaning, and analysis of large datasets from multiple sources, including loan performance, customer data, financial transactions, and treasury operations.
 



 Utilize Excel for advanced data analysis, including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, macros, and complex formulas to generate insights.
 



 Build and maintain automated reports and interactive dashboards to track key financial metrics using Excel, Tableau.
 



 Support decision\-making processes by providing actionable insights and trends derived from data, particularly focusing on financial and treasury\-related information.
 



 Collaborate with product, marketing, and operations teams to improve business performance through data\-backed recommendations.
 



 Conduct A/B testing and statistical analysis to evaluate the impact of business experiments and initiatives.
 



 Use SQL for querying databases to extract and manipulate data efficiently.
 



 Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and quality of data through validation and best practices, with a specific focus on treasury and financial data.
 



 Present findings to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including senior management.
 



  





**Skills \& Qualifications:** 




 Preferred is Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
 



 Strong expertise in Excel for data analysis and reporting, including advanced functions like pivot tables, macros, and formula\-based analysis, especially with financial and treasury data.
 



 Experience with SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
 



 Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI.
 



 Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex datasets and provide actionable insights, particularly in financial contexts.
 



 Experience with financial numbers and treasury operations is a primary requirement.
 



 Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
 



 Excellent communication skills for presenting data\-driven insights to cross\-functional teams.
 



  





**What We Offer:** 




 A fast\-paced work environment in a growing fintech company.
 



 Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.
 



 Learning and growth opportunities within a collaborative, inclusive team culture.

title: Fresher - SQL Developer
description:
**About Zyphra Tech**
 Zyphra Tech is a fast\-growing staffing and technology services company, offering end\-to\-end recruitment and workforce solutions to businesses across industries. We pride ourselves on matching the right talent with the right opportunities through innovation and dedication.
   

**SQL Developer (Fresher) – Job Description**
**About the Role**

 We are looking for a detail\-oriented
 **SQL Developer (Fresher)** 
 to work with databases, write queries, and support data\-related operations. This role is ideal for candidates who have strong basics in SQL and want to build a career in data and backend development.
   

  




**Key Responsibilities**
* Write and execute
 **SQL queries** 
 to retrieve and manipulate data
* Design, create, and maintain database tables and structures
* Perform data validation, cleaning, and troubleshooting
* Optimize queries for better performance
* Generate reports based on business requirements
* Work with developers and analysts to support data needs
* Ensure data accuracy and integrity


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field
* Strong knowledge of
 **SQL (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, Subqueries)**
* Understanding of
 **database concepts (tables, indexes, relationships)**
* Basic knowledge of
 **RDBMS (MySQL / PostgreSQL / SQL Server)**
* Familiarity with
 **MS Excel**
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Attention to detail


**Preferred Skills (Bonus)**
* Knowledge of
 **stored procedures, triggers, and views**
* Basic understanding of
 **data analysis concepts**
* Familiarity with
 **Power BI / Tableau**
* Internship or academic project experience in databases


**What We Offer**
* Entry\-level opportunity with training support
* Hands\-on experience with real\-time data projects
* Career growth in Data Analyst / Database roles
* Supportive team environment
* Competitive salary \+ incentives

title: Campus Graduate 2025-2026-8
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
   

  

 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**About You And This Role**
 As a Campus Graduate in the Supply Chain Rotational Program, you will embark on a two\-year journey designed to build a strong foundation in supply chain management, logistics, and process improvement. This program offers a unique opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across multiple functions, including business supply chain operations, logistics execution, and strategic improvement initiatives.
   

  

 You will be part of a dynamic team that operates at the intersection of innovation and operational excellence. Through rotations, you will learn how to balance customer demand with production capabilities, optimize inventory, and ensure timely delivery of materials—all while contributing to cost efficiency and sustainability goals.
   

  

 This role is ideal for individuals who are curious, analytical, and eager to learn. You will apply conceptual knowledge of supply chain theories and business practices to solve real\-world challenges. Collaboration is key—you will work cross\-functionally with manufacturing, procurement, and logistics teams to deliver value to customers and stakeholders.
   

  

 Your contributions will directly impact on operational performance and customer satisfaction. While you will work independently on assigned tasks, you will also have access to mentorship and structured learning opportunities to accelerate your professional growth. By the end of the program, you will have developed a holistic understanding of supply chain management and be prepared for a career in a global organization that values innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Production Planning: Determine what, when, and where to produce for one or multiple sites to meet customer demand efficiently.
* Material Availability: Ensure timely and cost\-effective availability of materials in desired quantities for smooth operations and customer delivery.
* Demand\-Supply Balancing: Collaborate cross\-functionally to align forecasted demand with production utilization, manage inventory levels, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Logistics Expertise: Provide technical knowledge and support for carrier management, warehouse operations, international trade compliance, and transport mode optimization.
* Process Improvement: Identify, assess, and support tactical or strategic projects aimed at reducing costs, improving quality, and enhancing customer service within supply chain or logistics functions.


**Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in supply chain management, Engineering, Business, Mathematics, or related disciplines.
* Strong analytical and logical thinking skills; ability to apply concepts to practical scenarios.


**Your Skills**
* Data Analysis: Ability to interpret and leverage data for decision\-making, forecasting, and performance optimization within supply chain operations.
* Quality Assurance (QA): Ensuring compliance with standards and maintaining accuracy in processes to deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes.
* Proactive Problem Solving: Anticipating challenges and implementing effective solutions to maintain operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Customer Service \& Client Counseling: Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, understanding their needs, and providing tailored solutions.
* Process Improvements \& Innovation: Identifying opportunities for efficiency, introducing innovative practices, and supporting continual improvement initiatives.
* Supply Chain Planning (SCP): Applying planning principles to balance demand and supply, optimize inventory, and ensure timely delivery of products.


**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
 We invest in you.
   

  

 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
   

  

 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
   

  

* Equitable and market\-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well\-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company\-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial\-goals.
+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role\-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non\-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one\-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On\-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:
+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon\-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)


 Join our team, we can make a difference together.
   

  

**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
 Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer\-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science\-based products and solutions in high\-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.

As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non\-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
   

  

 As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. title: PROJECT MANAGER L2
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
  

**Role** 




 The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery
   

  
 


 ͏ ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
   

 \- Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
   

 \- Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
   

 \- Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
   

 \- Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
   

 \- Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
   

 \- Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
   

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
 



 \- Client Relationship Management
   

 \- Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients
   

 \- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
   

  
 


 ͏
 
 Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
   

 \- Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
   

 \- Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
 



 \- Delivery governance across the project
   

 \- Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
   

 \- Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
 



 \- Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
   

 \- Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
   

 \- Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
   

 \- Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks
 



 \- Operational Excellence
   

 \- Automation Focus
   

 \- Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
   

 \- Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
 



  

 \- Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
   

  
 


 ͏
 
 \- Innovation Focus
   

 \- Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
   

 \- Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
 



 \- Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
 



 \- Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing 
   

 \- Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
   

 \- Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
 



 \- Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
   

 \- Demand forecasting in line with business requirements 
   

 \- Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
   

 \- Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements
 



  

 \- Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
   

 \- Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
 



 \- Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements 
   

 \- Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
   

 \- Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
 



 \- Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
   

 \- Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
 



 \- Fresher engagement program
   

 \- Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
 



 \- Team Management
   

 \- Resourcing
   

 \- Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
   

 \- Hire adequate and right resources for the team
 



 \- Talent Management
   

 \- Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
   

 \- Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
 



  

 \- Manage team attrition
   

 \- Drive diversity in leadership positions
   

 \- Performance Management
   

 \- Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
   

 \- Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
 



 \- Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
   

 \- Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
   

 \- Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
 



 \- Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
 







 Mandatory Skills: Telecom Network Content Security .
 



  
 



 Experience: \>10 YEARS
   

 .
 



  
 



 Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: PROJECT MANAGER L1
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
  

**Role** 




 The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
   

 \- Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
   

 \- Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
   

 \- Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
   

 \- Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
   

 \- Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
   

 \- Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
   

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
 



 \- Client Relationship Management
   

 \- Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients
   

 \- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
 



 \- Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
   

 \- Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
   

 \- Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
 



 \- Delivery governance across the project
   

 \- Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
   

 \- Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
 



 \- Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
   

 \- Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
   

 \- Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
   

 \- Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks
 


 ͏
 
 \- Operational Excellence
   

 \- Automation Focus
   

 \- Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
   

 \- Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
 



  

 \- Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
 



 \- Innovation Focus
   

 \- Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
   

 \- Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
 



 \- Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
 



 \- Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing 
   

 \- Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
   

 \- Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
 



 \- Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
   

 \- Demand forecasting in line with business requirements 
   

 \- Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
   

 \- Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements
 



  

 \- Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
   

 \- Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
 



 \- Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements 
   

 \- Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
   

 \- Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
 



 \- Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
   

 \- Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
 



 \- Fresher engagement program
   

 \- Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
 



 \- Team Management
   

 \- Resourcing
   

 \- Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
   

 \- Hire adequate and right resources for the team
 



 \- Talent Management
   

 \- Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
   

 \- Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
 



  

 \- Manage team attrition
   

 \- Drive diversity in leadership positions
   

 \- Performance Management
   

 \- Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
   

 \- Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
 



 \- Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
   

 \- Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
   

 \- Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
 



 \- Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
   

  
 


 ͏
 
 Deliver
 



  
   

 1\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ Client satisfaction
   

  
   

 PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
   

  
   

 2\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ operational efficiency
   

  
   

 Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects
   

  
   

 3\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ Financials
   

  
   

 Revenue target achievement, Operating margin %, leakage from OB to revenue, revenue per employee, CR realization target, process exceptions to be minimized, bench cost % of total cost, underrun % target for FPP projects, effort saving through NG\-1, NG\-2 initiatives
   

  
   

 5\.
   

  
   

 Capability Building
   

  
   

 % attrition, critical talent attrition%, % trained on new age skills, % of team trained in necessary behavioural skills, diversity ratio, % localization targets by market, billable rookie ratio, rookie/NJNB assimilation TATs, offshore mix
   

  
   

 6\.
   

  
   

 Team Management
   

  
   

 Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score
   

  
 


 ͏
 




 Mandatory Skills: Automotive .
 



  
 



 Experience: 8\-10 Years
   

 .
 



  
 



 Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Sales Development Representative — IT Services | Fresher | On-Site Dharamshala
description:
**VarenyaZ is hiring a full\-time, on\-site Sales Development Representative / Business Development Trainee to support client prospecting for the USA and UK markets.** 




  





 This is a fresher\-friendly role for candidates who have strong English communication skills, confidence in speaking with international prospects, and an interest in IT services, software development, AI, web/mobile development, and digital transformation.
 



  





 The selected candidate will be trained to identify potential clients, generate qualified leads, reach out to decision\-makers through LinkedIn, email, and calls, and support the sales team in building a strong international client pipeline.
 



  





**Work Location:** 




 On\-site only — Dari, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176057
 



  





**Role Type:** 




 Full\-time, office\-based
 



  





**Experience:** 




 Freshers can apply. 0–1 year experience preferred.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 \-\-\> The candidate will be responsible for:
 



 \-\-\> Researching potential clients in the USA and UK markets.
 



 \-\-\> Identifying decision\-makers such as founders, CEOs, CTOs, product heads, and business owners.
 



 \-\-\> Generating leads for IT services such as web development, mobile app development, AI solutions, SaaS, CRM, ERP, cloud, and custom software development.
 



 \-\-\> Creating prospect lists using LinkedIn, Google, company websites, directories, and other online sources.
 



 \-\-\> Reaching out to prospects through LinkedIn messages, cold emails, and introductory calls.
 



 \-\-\> Understanding client requirements at a basic level and passing qualified opportunities to the senior sales team.
 



 \-\-\> Maintaining lead records, follow\-ups, and communication history in CRM or internal tracking sheets.
 



 \-\-\> Writing clear and professional business communication for international clients.
 



 \-\-\> Supporting email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, and appointment\-setting activities.
 



 \-\-\> Meeting weekly and monthly lead generation and meeting\-booking targets.
 



  





**Candidate Requirements** 




 \-\-\> Freshers are welcome.
 



 \-\-\> Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory.
 



 \-\-\> Comfortable communicating with USA and UK prospects.
 



 \-\-\> Good listening skills and confidence in professional conversations.
 



 \-\-\> Basic understanding of IT services, websites, mobile apps, software, AI, or digital products is preferred.
 



 \-\-\> Ability to research companies and understand basic business needs.
 



 \-\-\> Comfortable with LinkedIn, email, Google search, and basic MS Excel/Google Sheets.
 



 \-\-\> Self\-motivated, target\-oriented, and open to feedback.
 



 \-\-\> Must be willing to work fully from office in Dari, Dharamshala.
 



 \-\-\> Must be comfortable with international prospecting and follow\-up work.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 \-\-\> BBA, MBA, B.Tech, BCA, MCA, BA, B.Com, or any graduate can apply.
 



 \-\-\> Candidates with internships, college projects, debating, public speaking, marketing, or sales exposure will be preferred.
 



 \-\-\> Prior experience in cold calling, lead generation, email marketing, LinkedIn outreach, or customer support is a plus, but not mandatory.
 



  





**Important Note for Candidates** 




 This is
 **not a software developer role** 
 .
 



 This is a
 **sales and business development role** 
 focused on international client prospecting for IT services.
 



  





 Training will be provided, but candidates must have strong communication skills, discipline, and willingness to learn.

title: Program Officer, Schools Program
description:
**About Us**
**About the role :**
 We are hiring a Program Officer to support the implementation of our Schools Program in 3 districts( Belgaum, Haveri, Vijayanagar) of Karnataka , Belgaum being the base location . This role will focus on effective program delivery, mentoring master trainers and teachers, facilitating student\-led innovation events like Ideathons and Hackathons, and managing district\-level stakeholder engagement. The ideal candidate will bring experience in teaching, strong training and communication skills, and a deep understanding of working with government systems and education programs.
   

  

* Hands\-on with the Sector/Module Content and Learning Outcomes


 Â· Build a strong understanding of the Schools Program, Ideathon and Hackathon process, chatbot milestones, sector/module content, and expected learning outcomes for 8th\-10th grade students.
   

  

 Â· Support Master Trainers (MTs) and teachers across Belgaum, Haveri, and Vijayanagar districts to understand and implement the content effectively in Karnataka Residential Educational Institutions Society (KREIS) schools.
   

  

 Â· Mentor and support MTs and teachers in planning and executing Ideathon and Hackathon activities with students.
   

  

 Â· Support school\-level Hackathons by helping students identify problem statements, develop solutions, and build prototypes through teacher and MT engagement.
   

  

 Â· Ensure chatbot content, milestones, and learning activities are understood and completed correctly by MTs, teachers, and students.
   

  

 Â· Identify learning gaps, best practices, and implementation challenges related to content delivery and share them with the program team for action.
   

  

* Timely and Effective Delivery of Sessions


 Â· Responsible for timely and effective program delivery through the Master Trainer cascade model across the assigned three districts \- Belgaum, Haveri, and Vijayanagar, with Belgaum as the base location.
   

  

 Â· Coordinate with the Program Coordinator, Learning Experience Officer, and Master Trainers to plan and execute cascade trainings at block and district levels.
   

  

 Â· Be present and actively support in\-person trainings at block and district levels.
   

  

 Â· Support Master Trainers to plan, design, and deliver sessions effectively as per program timelines and quality expectations.
   

  

 Â· Ensure MTs and teachers conduct Ideathon and Hackathon sessions with 8th\-10th grade students as per the agreed implementation plan.
   

  

 Â· Organise and co\-facilitate school\-level Hackathons and district\-level share\-out events for students and teachers to showcase their work.
   

  

 Â· Conduct regular phone calls and school visits to observe classroom engagement and provide on\-ground support to MTs and teachers.
   

  

 Â· Organise and facilitate bi\-monthly catch\-up calls with Master Trainers to review post\-training engagement, achievements, challenges, and next steps.
   

  

* Relationship Management \- Students, Internal Team and Team Management


 Â· Build strong working relationships with students, Master Trainers, teachers, school heads, district government officials, and the internal program team to ensure smooth implementation of the Schools Program.
   

  

 Â· Act as the focal point for MTs, teachers, and school heads in assigned schools and keep them informed about program progress, plans, timelines, and deliverables.
   

  

 Â· Work closely with the internal team to align on district\-level planning, school visits, trainings, reviews, documentation, and follow\-up actions.
   

  

 Â· Participate in program team meetings, block\-level and district\-level reviews, and planning discussions as required.
   

  

 Â· Coordinate with team members and assigned stakeholders to ensure responsibilities, timelines, and follow\-up actions are clearly tracked and completed.
   

  

 Â· Design and facilitate CoP and WhatsApp engagement plans to nudge, clarify doubts, and share reflections on Ideathon and Hackathon content and process with MTs and teachers.
   

  

 Â· Facilitate and document quarterly MT catch\-ups with the District and DIET Department to share field updates, implementation shifts, and impact.
   

  

* Reporting, M\&E and Data Management


 Â· Support the M\&E team in implementing monitoring tools as per the project framework.
   

  

 Â· Maintain accurate data and documentation related to cascade trainings, school visits, meetings, events, MT engagement, teacher engagement, student engagement, chatbot completion, and milestone progress.
   

  

 Â· Compile field\-level reports and data as per the framework and submit them within agreed timelines.
   

  

 Â· Regularly check dashboard data to ensure it is updated, error\-free, and aligned with M\&E requirements.
   

  

 Â· Report dashboard issues, chatbot glitches, and technical challenges related to content or data, and follow up with the Ed\-Tech team for resolution.
   

  

 Â· Provide regular written and verbal reports tracking progress against the work plan and implementation schedules.
   

  

 Â· Document and share best practices from schools for monthly and quarterly reports.
   

  

 Â· Support documentation of trainings, meetings, school visits, events, Hackathons, share\-out events, and review meetings.
   

  

 Â· Support the coordination of baseline, endline, and other assessments as required.
   

  

 Â· Document and design follow\-up plans for selected learners who need deeper intervention and support for transition into higher education.
   

  

 Â· Ensure M\&E adherence, data quality, and timely reporting across all assigned schools and districts.
   

  

* Adherence to Systems and Processes


 Â· Ensure adherence to organizational systems, processes, timelines, and reporting protocols.
   

  

 Â· Follow all finance, HR, travel, procurement, and operational policies of Quest Alliance.
   

  

 Â· Ensure people and financial policies and procedures are followed during program implementation.
   

  

 Â· Participate in team meetings, reviews, and staff engagement activities.
   

  

 Â· Maintain proper documentation for trainings, meetings, events, travel, field visits, and program activities.
   

  

 Â· Uphold the values and professional standards of Quest Alliance while working with schools, government stakeholders, students, teachers, MTs, and internal teams.
   

  

* Learning \& Growth Goals


 Â· Identify development needs based on role requirements, review feedback, 360\-degree feedback, and personal growth goals.
   

  

 Â· Create a clear self\-learning and development goal for the year with timeline, mode of learning, and support required.
   

  

 Â· Take ownership of tracking progress against learning goals and completing agreed self\-learning goals within the planned timeline.
   

  

 Â· Actively seek support, mentoring, and feedback from the reporting manager, program team, and relevant internal stakeholders.
   

  

 Â· Apply new learning to improve program delivery, stakeholder engagement, M\&E quality, data management, reporting, team management, and field implementation.
   

  

**Required Skills And Experience**
 Â· 1–2 years’ experience in teaching, mentoring, or education program delivery
   

  

 Â· Proven experience working with government stakeholders
   

  

 Â· Strong skills in training delivery, communication, and report writing
   

  

 Â· Willingness to travel frequently within districts
   

  

 Â· Fluency in Kannada (spoken and written)
   

  

 Â· Brownie Points: Prior exposure to or interest in STEM mindset, computational thinking or critical thinking approaches in education
   

  

**Salary** 
 : The pay band for the position starts at Rs. 37,000/\- per month (cost to company) (The salary offered will be commensurate with the experience and expertise of the candidate)
   

  

**Contract Duration** 
 : Fixed\-term contract for 11 months, from May 2026 to March 2027\.
   

  

**Know About Quest**
 Website : http://www.questalliance.net/
   

  

 Blog : https://thelearnerbyquest.wordpress.com

 Bengaluru

 Full\-Time

 Fresher / Entry\-Level

 IT Support

 We are seeking a highly motivated
 **IT Support Trainee** 
 to join our IT Support team. This entry\-level role is designed for fresh graduates who are eager to build a career in enterprise IT systems and technical support. The trainee will gain practical exposure to
 **ERP/CRM platforms (SAP Business One, Salesforce), SQL/RDBMS, Windows Server, and MS Office Administration** 
 , while supporting daily IT operations and end\-user needs.
