* Provide first\-level technical support for ERP/CRM systems (SAP B1, Salesforce).
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to SQL/RDBMS databases, connectivity, and backups.
* Assist in Windows Server administration including user accounts, permissions, and system monitoring.
* Manage MS Office 365 applications (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint) for end\-users.
* Document support requests, resolutions, and maintain IT logs for compliance and reporting.
* Collaborate with senior IT staff on system upgrades, patches, and integration projects.
* Participate in testing, validation, and reporting activities related to IT systems.
* Ensure adherence to IT security protocols, data privacy, and organizational policies.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree/diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Basic understanding of ERP systems (SAP B1 preferred) and CRM platforms (Salesforce).
* Familiarity with SQL/RDBMS concepts and Windows Server fundamentals.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.


**Essential Skills (Must\-Have)**
* Basic IT Knowledge \- Understanding of computer hardware, operating systems (Windows), and networking fundamentals.
* ERP/CRM Awareness \- Familiarity with SAP Business One and/or Salesforce at a basic level (even academic/project exposure).
* Database Fundamentals \- Knowledge of SQL and RDBMS concepts (queries, tables, relationships, backups).
* Windows Server Basics \- User account management, permissions, and system monitoring.
* MS Office Administration \- Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and basic Office 365 tools.
* Problem\-Solving Ability \- Logical thinking and troubleshooting skills to resolve user issues.
* Communication Skills \- Clear verbal and written communication for interacting with end\-users and documenting issues.
* Teamwork Adaptability \- Ability to collaborate with senior IT staff and willingness to learn new technologies quickly.


**What We Offer**
* Structured training and mentorship in IT support.
* Exposure to enterprise\-grade systems and real\-world IT operations.
* Career growth opportunities in ERP, database, and IT administration domains.
* A collaborative and supportive work environment.

description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience with TCP/IP\-based, routing, and network management protocols.

**Preferred qualifications:**

**About the job** 
 Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services. Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.

* Design and execute functional, integration, performance, and system\-level testing for network devices and management systems.
* Drive the creation and enhancement of scalable test automation frameworks, tools, and infrastructure.
* Collaborate with Network Architecture, Software Engineering, and Product teams to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle and influence design for testability.
* Diagnose and resolve issues across multi\-vendor network environments.

description:
**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:** 



* Perform duties as an individual contributor and team member with 100% hands\-on work to develop, review, update, and publish regulatory\-compliant documentation, including IFUs, Product Manuals, Getting Started Guides, and Service Manuals.
* Document product functionalities and manage documentation reviews to verify that technical information for Xpert tests and GeneXpert systems.
* Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs and Clinical teams to ensure documentation meets user needs and technical accuracy within a regulated environment.
* Create high\-quality, localization\-ready content designed for seamless adaptation across global regions.
* Build deep knowledge of company processes, molecular diagnostic technologies (like PCR), and customer needs to drive continuous quality improvements.







**The essential requirements of the job include:** 








* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Technical Communication, English, Life Sciences, or a related Engineering field (e.g., Biomedical).
* 3–6 years of professional technical writing or software validation testing experience in a strictly regulated environment such as Medical Devices, IVD, or Biotechnology. Strong experience in Adobe InDesign, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Camtasia for video creation.

* Mastery of professional authoring tools (e.g., Vasont, MadCap Flare, FrameMaker) and a strong working knowledge of document management and version control systems.
* Excellent interpersonal and writing skills, with the self\-motivation to quickly learn new molecular diagnostic technologies, such as PCR and clinical lab workflows.







**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:** 



* Ability to manage translation workflows for global markets and lead small projects, including training or mentoring colleagues to ensure high product quality and customer satisfaction.

 The Technical Documentation team within R\&D for Separation technologies recruits a Technical Writer.
   

  

 As a Technical Writer you are responsible for the delivery of Documentation that meets the demands of external and internal stakeholders in the best possible way.
   

  

**As a Technical Writer – System Documentation You Will**
* Collaborate with the Design lead to create, update, and maintain the HSS system documentation, primarily separator systems.
* Responsible for creating, updating and maintaining system manuals intended for customer use (Includes instructions regarding HMI, operation, installation guidelines, service/maintenance, operation, safety, alarm troubleshooting, etc.)
* Develop and maintain the system manuals as per the standard set of documentation life cycles for new as well as existing products as per guidelines.
* Create and maintain spare part catalogues for service function and customers.
* Create/order illustrations, structure, layout, text, and images for the technical documentation material. Tools we use: Corel draw, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop and Creo Illustrate
* Active participation in the development of tools and methods within the field of technical documentation
* Develop and maintain the system manuals in the PDM system \- Teamcenter
* In collaboration with the design lead work on the future digitalization activities of the documentation

The main beneficiaries of the work are our internal sales organization, our customers, Parts and Service and Operations. Work with external contacts, among others translation agency, consulting agencies for technical documentation, etc.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Technical Communication, Engineering, Science, or related field (essential). Master’s Degree \- good to have.

* Good understanding and knowledge of the process, functional and software design description

description:

 Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
   

  

 At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

 Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life\-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.
   

  

 At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life\-changing career.

 The Senior Technical Writer is responsible for for the creation of customer\-facing user documentation in a manner that meets corporate standards and style.
   

  

 This position reports to the Techdoc Manager and is part of the Technical Documentation Group located in Pune and will be an on\-site role. At Cytiva, our vision is, to advance future therapeutics from discovery to delivery.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Research, write, edit, review, proof\-read, and publish end\-user documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, validity, and clarity of information for digital and/or print production in line with corporate standards for style, branding and quality, legal guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Work with other functions (such as product management, research \& development, engineering,, regulatory, manufacturing, and project management office) for the timely and cost\-effective production of new documents and maintenance of existing documents.

**Who You Are**
* MSc degree, preferably in Life Science, or related field; or BSc Science preferably Life Science or related field with relevant work experience.
* 2\+ years of progressively responsible experience in the structured writing, editing, and production of technical documentation (e.g., operating instructions manuals).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability in original technical writing, document organization, document reorganization; experience editing others’ work.
* Experience of SDL Tridion or other XML based DITA Content Management Systems desirable.
* Proficient in desktop publishing tools for example Adobe InDesign, Photoshop and Illustrator.


**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**
* Knowledge of Cytiva products.
* Experience of CAD related tools.

 Your role, your entry point at AFRY

 Your key responsibilities
   

  

* Produce basis for APD\-plans (Construction site layouts)
* Produce basis for TA\-plan ( Traffic arrangement plan)
* Help make clash controls in models regarding to work environment legislations
* Produce drawings showing construction machines and work steps in models to make sure there is enough space to build.
* Produce cross sections to verify buildability


**Qualifications**
 We expect that you have
   

  

* A Qualified Degree in Civil Engineering from a reputed College
* 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in civil engineering with a focus on public spaces. Water and drainage or road design and familiar with design programs used for this type of design
* Working knowledge of Autocad / Civil 3D / Revit
* Good written and verbal English language (CEFR minimum level B1\)
* A good knowledge of working in all applications of MS Office
* Very good communication skills.


 We appreciate if you have
   

  

* Experience of working abroad, especially projects in the Nordics
* Interest in construction and health and safety
* Experience of making illustrations in Bluebeam Revu or similar applications
* Experience of visual planning of construction sites
* Experience of producing APD\-plans or TA\-plans in Swedish projects


**Additional Information**
 We appreciate if you have
   

  

* Experience of working abroad, especially projects in the Nordics
* Interest in construction and health and safety


*At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.*

title: Product Business Analyst
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 As a Product Business Analyst within the Digital Transformation team, you will play a critical role in supporting the design, development, and continuous improvement of our digital insurance products. You will work closely with Product Managers, UX teams, Engineering, and key stakeholders to translate customer needs and business requirements into scalable product solutions. You will be responsible for gathering and documenting requirements, collaborating with stakeholders, optimizing processes, and ensuring high\-quality delivery of features.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone detail\-oriented with strong analytical and communication skills.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



**Product Requirement Management** 




 • Collaborate with Product Managers \&/or business stakeholders to gather, define, and refine business/product requirements.
 



 • Translate business objectives into clear, actionable user stories, workflows and acceptance criteria. • Maintain product documentation such as process flows, release notes, and backlog items.
 



 • Manage and groom the product backlog using tools like JIRA, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
 



 • Support the creation and maintenance of project plans, test cases, and go\-to\-market plans.
 **Stakeholder Collaboration** 




 • Act as the bridge between business, product, UX, and technology teams to ensure clarity \& alignment.
 



 • Facilitate workshops and interviews with internal and external stakeholders to capture pain points and opportunities.
 



 • Support product discovery activities (journey mapping, persona definition, MVP scoping.
 



 • Provide training and support to internal teams on the use of the new digital systems.
 



 • Participate in sprint ceremonies, requirement walkthroughs, and backlog refinement sessions.
 **Process Optimization** 




 • Map current (‘as\-is’) and future state (‘to\-be’) customer journeys and operational workflows.
 



 • Identify inefficiencies or manual touchpoints that can be automated or optimized, and propose improvements.
 



 • Collaborate with operations and tech teams to streamline processes.
 



**Data\-Driven Decision Support** 




 • Conduct market and competitor analysis to recommend product enhancements.
 



 • Track product performance metrics and prepare reports for decision\-making.
 



**Quality \& Testing Support** 




 • Support UAT planning and execution by aligning business users and ensuring traceability of requirements.
 



 • Validate that product features meet the intended outcomes before go\-live.
 



**Operational Excellence** 




 • Ensure documentation, artifacts, and reporting adhere to team standards.
 



 • Create / maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and internal process documentation.
 



 • Support consistency in delivery across projects through reusable templates and checklists. • Contribute to knowledge\-sharing within the product team.
 



  





**Key Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
 



 • 3–6 years of business analysis experience in digital platforms, preferably in insurance, fintech, or e\- commerce.
 



 • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with cross\-functional product squads.
 



 • Familiarity with SDLC and product lifecycle practices.
 



  





**Core Skills** 




 • Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; proficiency with SQL, Excel, or BI tools is a plus.
 



 • Familiarity with customer journey tools (e.g., Miro, Figma, MS Visio) and backlog management systems (e.g., JIRA).
 



 • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to distill complex information clearly.
 



 • Exposure to APIs, product integrations, or digital onboarding flows is a plus.
 



 • Understanding of health or general insurance products (quote, bind, issue, claim) is highly desirable.
 



 • Experience working in regulated environments or with compliance teams is a plus.
 



 • Comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast\-evolving, startup\-like environments.
 



 • Product mindset with a focus on outcomes, not just deliverables.
 



 • Exposure to quality standards, process controls, and knowledge management practices, especially from an operational excellence perspective is a plus.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 • Work at the forefront of digital insurance transformation in the MENA region.
 



 • Be part of a high\-impact product team driving innovation in customer experience.
 



 • Flexible, collaborative, and diverse team culture.
 



 • Opportunities for professional growth and exposure to end\-to\-end product development.

description:

 **Backend Engineer** 
 to join our core engineering team. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a sense of ownership and accountability. The position involves end\-to\-end responsibility \- from architecture and development to deployment and monitoring \- in a modern, cloud\-native environment.

* 1–3 years of backend development experience with strong fundamentals in system design, distributed systems, and networking.
* Proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js (NestJS).
* Bonus: Experience with Python and FastAPI.
* Hands\-on experience with event\-driven architectures and cloud\-native deployments.
* Strong debugging, performance optimization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven track record of end\-to\-end ownership of backend components.


**Technical Stack \& Tools**
* Languages, Frameworks \& Databases
* TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS
* Bonus: Python, FastAPI
* MongoDB, Redis
* GraphQL, REST API’s
* Query optimization, caching, indexing, sharding
* Data Structures, Algorithms and Problem Solving
* Infrastructure \& Cloud
* Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/ECS)
* AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, CloudWatch, API Gateway, Secrets Manager


**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and develop scalable, reliable, and secure backend systems and microservices.

* Implement asynchronous communication and event\-driven architectures using Kafka, queues, and pub/sub systems.

* Manage deployments and operational aspects of backend services, ensuring performance and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with product, frontend, and infrastructure teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.

Infinite Convergence Solutions, Inc. is an industry leader that provides next\-generation messaging and mobility solutions to carriers and enterprises globally, including its enterprise\-grade, secure mobile messaging platform \- NetSfere Enterprise; customer engagement platform \- NetSfere Omnichannel and complete range of scalable next\-generation wireless communication technologies \- NetSfere Mobile Solutions.
   

  

 With a rich heritage based on acquisitions from Motorola, Nokia, and Alcatel\-Lucent and with 2000\+ years of combined experience in mobile and messaging technologies, the company's platforms support more than 500 million subscribers by sending over one trillion messages per year. Headquartered outside Chicago, with offices in the United States, Germany, UK, India, and Singapore, Infinite Convergence is a subsidiary of Infinite Computer Solutions. For more information, visit www.infinite\-convergence.com and www.netsfere.com.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Infinite Convergence Solutions is looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer (Front\-end) to join our growing NetSfere Enterprise team. The NetSfere Enterprise team is transforming the way businesses communicate and collaborate with its industry leading cloud\-based platform built from the grounds up with the enterprise in mind, offering the most holistic, secure, all\-in\-one communication solution on the market. Created with end\-to\-end encryption and full IT administrative control, the platform is designed to enhance team collaboration and drive workplace productivity through a more contextual, seamless communications experience with voice, video and text messaging, while allowing the enterprise to maintain control and regulatory compliance such as GDPR, HIPAA and more.
   

  

 The candidate for this role should have a passion for solving technical and business challenges. You will work with a collaborative team of architects and engineers and will have the opportunity to make a significant impact in solving our customer’s toughest challenges, while working on the latest technologies learning new technologies, tool, and languages.
   

  

 The candidate should be willing to travel to our Engineering Center in Chicago for in depth product training and to collaborate with the team on deliverables as and when required.
   

  

**Requirements**
* BS in Computer Science or Software Engineering

* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
* Good understanding of software development fundamentals
* Knowledge of data structures, databases, networks and algorithms
* Good understanding of information security concepts
* Experience building single\-page web applications
* Knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3

* Strong verbal and written communication skills

* Experience working as part of an Agile team
